trial_title: Metformin Clinical Trial for Diabetes Management
subject: Clinical Research Participation Opportunity: Type 2 Diabetes Management Study
body:
Dear Patient,

Our clinical research division at Memorial Cancer Institute is currently evaluating novel glycemic management strategies for adults with Type 2 Diabetes.

Based on preliminary clinical criteria review under IRB Protocol #IRB-2026-089, you may be eligible to participate in a clinical study investigating optimized Metformin therapy.

Participation is entirely voluntary and does not impact your standard medical care. Study visits, lab evaluations, and study medication are provided at no cost.

To learn more or speak with a study coordinator, please contact our team at (555) 019-2834.

Sincerely,
Clinical Research Operations Team

subject: Invitation to Participate in Atrial Fibrillation Anticoagulation Research
body:
Dear Patient,

You are invited to participate in a clinical study assessing individualized anticoagulation therapies for individuals diagnosed with non-valvular atrial fibrillation.

Your potential eligibility was verified through our automated clinical matching pipeline (IRB Protocol #IRB-2026-012). If you choose to join, your clinical progress will be closely monitored by our cardiology team.

Please contact our coordinator office to discuss protocol details.
